column3: “torn away from you” renders “seized from before you”; “sheep” renders “flock.”
“there shall be nothing you can do” renders “there is no power in your hand.”
“do not know” renders “have not known”; “never be anything but” renders “only.”
“the sight of what you see” renders “the sights of your eyes which you see.”
“sore boils” renders “bad boils”; “crown of your head” renders “scalp.”
“The cricket” renders a word for a kind of locust; the exact insect is uncertain.
“obey the LORD” renders “listen to the voice of the LORD.”
“fierce countenance” renders “fierce of face”; “have no respect for” renders “not lift up face for.”
“offspring of your herd” renders “fruit of your livestock”; “they have caused you to perish” renders the Hebrew singular “it destroys you.”
“offspring of your own body” renders “fruit of your womb.”
“refined” renders “gentle”; “shall be hostile” renders “his eye shall be evil,” and “the wife he cherishes” renders “the wife of his bosom.”
“shall be hostile” renders “her eye shall be evil”; “the husband she cherishes” renders “the husband of her bosom.”
“bring extraordinary plagues” renders “make your plagues extraordinary”; “miserable” renders “harmful.”
“all the diseases” renders the Hebrew singular “every disease.”
